_comment: Published performance of current PET systems, as used in Table 2 of
'Comparing short and long PET systems on a resolution-dependent task'.
Lengths in mm, coincidence time resolution in ps, energies in keV, all
resolutions FWHM, S_nema in cps/kBq for the centred NEMA NU 2 line source.
L_mrd null means no ring-difference limit; ctr null means no time of flight;
'assumed' lists fields taken from a similar system rather than measured on
this one.  Adding a system here needs no change to any code.

systems.name: Biograph Vision.X
systems.note: Same detector as the Vision 600 after an electronics upgrade: only the CTR differs (ref. 9). The remaining entries are those of the original, for which alone a peer-reviewed evaluation exists.

systems.name: Biograph Vision Quadra
systems.note: Ultra-high-sensitivity mode: all ring differences accepted.

systems.name: Omni Legend 32
systems.note: The energy resolution is asserted in the discussion of ref. 5 rather than measured in it.

systems.name: Omni 128
systems.note: No published performance evaluation. The resolutions are those of the Omni Legend 32, which uses the same detector, so the r values in this row rest on that assumption.

systems.name: uMI Panorama
systems.note: D_pet is unpublished; 788 mm is inferred from the 62 degree maximum acceptance angle quoted for the GS, consistent with the 786 mm of the uEXPLORER.

systems.name: uMI Panorama GS
systems.note: D_pet inferred as for the uMI Panorama.

references.1: J. van Sluis et al., J. Nucl. Med. 60 (2019) 1031; energy resolution, window and ring diameter from J. S. Reddin et al., IEEE NSS/MIC (2018) 1.
references.2: G. A. Prenosil et al., J. Nucl. Med. 63 (2022) 476.
references.3: A. Chicheportiche et al., EJNMMI Phys. 7 (2020) 4; resolution and energy resolution from D. F. C. Hsu et al., J. Nucl. Med. 58 (2017) 1511; ring diameter from D. Vandendriessche et al., EJNMMI Phys. 6 (2019) 8.
references.4: K. G. Zeimpekis et al., Eur. J. Nucl. Med. Mol. Imaging 49 (2022) 3023.
references.5: S. Yamagishi et al., J. Nucl. Med. 64 (2023) 1990.
references.6: GE HealthCare product information (no published NEMA evaluation).
references.7: G. Li et al., J. Nucl. Med. 65 (2024) 652.
references.8: H. Zhang et al., J. Nucl. Med. 65 (2024) 1974.
references.9: H. Zaidi et al., J. Nucl. Med. 66 (2025) suppl. 1, 251754 (abstract).

conventions.F_t: F_t = (c/2) x CTR = 0.15 mm/ps x CTR.
conventions.energy_resolution: FWHM of the 511 keV photopeak, in per cent.
conventions.F_y: Mean of the radial and tangential NEMA point-source FWHM at 1 cm from the axis, reconstructed by filtered backprojection.
conventions.F_z: Axial NEMA point-source FWHM at 1 cm from the axis.
conventions.S_nema: NEMA NU 2 sensitivity for the centred line source, cps/kBq.
